item.title: Mother Russia #1-3
item.description: Stalingrad. 1943. One baby. One rifle. Two million zombies. A soviet sniper risks her life to protect something she hasn’t seen in a long time: A perfectly healthy two year old boy who has just stumbled right into the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Note: The digital edition (11/18/2015) for this volume was released before the print edition.
